title: finding(platform-objects): five system objects declare `nameField: id` beside a `titleFormat` — once objectui honours ADR-0079's order (objectui#9436), their record-page H1 becomes the raw record id
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat (seat #1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`). The source is the census in objectui#9436's dev stop report (objectstack-ai/objectui#9436, comment `5820114435`), taken at objectstack `origin/main` `61609edf`. ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Fact

objectui is moving its record page to the order ADR-0079 and `@objectstack/spec`'s own `titleFormat` describe declare: 「an explicit nameField now takes precedence」. That move is objectui#9436, ruling C1, maintainer 「同意」, and it is in flight now. The census of objectstack objects that declare both keys:

- 71 non-test source files carry a `titleFormat` key. 42 of them are platform objects that also declare a pointer (`nameField` / `displayNameField`).
- 26 of the 42 have a single-field template equal to the pointer, so nothing visible changes.
- **16 render something else, so their H1 will move.** Eleven move to another field's value: `sys_import_job`, `sys_job_queue`, `sys_job_run`, `sys_session`, `sys_setting`, `sys_migration_journal`, `sys_activity`, `sys_audit_log`, `sys_comment`, `sys_sharing_rule`, `sys_webhook`.
- ⚠️ **Five declare `nameField: id`**, so their H1 becomes the raw record id: `sys_approval_action`, `sys_approval_approver`, `sys_approval_request`, `sys_automation_run`, `sys_http_delivery`.

## Why it is objectstack's

The metadata is objectstack's. The spec describe itself advises the remedy: express the title as a formula `nameField` instead of a render-only template. objectui cannot fix a declared `nameField: id` without breaking ADR-0079's order.

## ⛔ Not claimed

- ⛔ No per-object remedy is chosen. The five `nameField: id` objects are the ones that visibly regress. The other eleven may be intended.
- ⛔ The census was taken by the objectui dev from the objectstack tree at `61609edf`. Re-run it before acting on it.
- ⛔ This card does not ask objectui#9436 to wait. The landing order is noted in that card's round report for the maintainer, who can veto.

## Dedupe words

`nameField id titleFormat` · `ADR-0079 record title raw id` · `sys_approval_request H1` · `formula nameField migration` · `titleFormat nameField census`
